target.title: fix: keep image attachments when steering active runs
target.body:
Closes #107434

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who sent an image while an agent run was already active would have the steering text accepted but the image attachment dropped, so the running agent could not inspect the media.

## Why This Change Was Made

Active-run steering now carries the current turn's ordered image inputs through the shared queue contract and serializes the same sanitized text-and-image input shape for both new Codex turns and `turn/steer`; OpenClaw's embedded runtime receives the same images through its existing session steering API. The main regression risk is changing text-only pending-input handling, so media-bearing turns bypass that text-only answer path while focused tests retain the existing behavior for turns without images.

## User Impact

Users can attach images while a run is active and expect those images to reach the same running turn in order. If a runtime rejects steering, the existing follow-up fallback remains unchanged.

## Evidence

- Live after-fix proof on a local Gateway with the native Codex app-server runtime and `openai/gpt-5.4`:
  1. Started a turn that invoked a 35-second tool call.
  2. While that run was active, sent a second `chat.send` turn with a generated PNG containing the random code `A5C27F` and asked the model to return only the code in the image.
  3. The original active run completed with exactly `A5C27F`; session history showed the image-bearing user turn before that assistant response.
- The issue's source reproduction is covered at each boundary: reply queue admission, embedded-session steering, Codex steering serialization, and the full Codex run-attempt path.
- Focused tests: 278 passed across:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner.media-paths.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.queue-message.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/attempt-steering.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.steering.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/runs.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner.runreplyagent.e2e.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/thread-lifecycle.test.ts`
- A clean Gateway launch rebuilt TypeScript and bundled plugin assets successfully; targeted `oxfmt` and `git diff --check` passed.
- Pre-commit autoreview reported no accepted or actionable findings.

AI-assisted: implementation and test review were assisted; the live behavior proof was run manually.
